lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ਝੂਠ ਧੰਧਿ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaise meethai saad lobhaae jhooth dha(n)dh duragaadhe ||2||
lines.translation: The sweet flavors tempt you, and you are occupied by your false and filthy business. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਇਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh ar lobh moh ih i(n)dree ras lapataadhe ||
lines.translation: Your senses are beguiled by sensual pleasures of sex, by anger, greed and emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਈ ਭਵਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: deeee bhavaaree purakh bidhaatai bahur bahur janamaadhe ||3||
lines.translation: The All-powerful Architect of Destiny has ordained that you shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan tau gur mil sabh sukh laadhe ||
lines.translation: When the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, then, as Gurmukh, you shall find absolute peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak din rain dhiaavau maar kaadhee sagal upaadhe ||4||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord, day and night, and all your sickness shall be banished. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: iu japio bhaaee purakh bidhaate ||
lines.translation: Meditate in this way, O Siblings of Destiny, on the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan janam maran dukh laathe ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||4||4||126||
lines.translation: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful; He has removed the pains of birth and death. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||126||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh kaam suaad kaaran kot dinas dukh paavahi ||
lines.translation: For a moment of sexual pleasure, you shall suffer in pain for millions of days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gharee muhat ra(n)g maanahi phir bahur bahur pachhutaavahi ||1||
lines.translation: For an instant, you may savor pleasure, but afterwards, you shall regret it, again and again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe chet har har raaiaa ||
lines.translation: O blind man, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa so din neRai aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your day is drawing near. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਲਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਕ ਨੀਮ ਕੋ ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: palak drisat dekh bhoolo aak neem ko too(n)mar ||
lines.translation: You are deceived, beholding with your eyes, the bitter melon and swallow-wort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਸਿਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa sa(n)g biseear siu hai re taiso hee ihu par grihu ||2||
lines.translation: But, like the companionship of a poisonous snake, so is the desire for another's spouse. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bairee kaaran paap karataa basat rahee amaanaa ||
lines.translation: For the sake of your enemy, you commit sins, while you neglect the reality of your faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: chhod jaahi tin hee siu sa(n)gee saajan siu bairaanaa ||3||
lines.translation: Your friendship is with those who abandon you, and you are angry with your friends. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal sa(n)saar ihai bidh biaapio so ubario jis gur pooraa ||
lines.translation: The entire world is entangled in this way; he alone is saved, who has the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bhav saagar tario bhae puneet sareeraa ||4||5||127||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean; my body has become sanctified. ||4||5||127||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupade ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl Dho-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: look kamaano soee tumh pekhio mooR mugadh mukaraanee ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You behold whatever we do in secrecy; the fool may stubbornly deny it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap kamaane kau le baa(n)dhe phir paachhai pachhutaanee ||1||
lines.translation: By his own actions, he is tied down, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh mere sabh bidh aagai jaanee ||
lines.translation: My God knows, ahead of time, all things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ ਪਰਦਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram ke moose too(n) raakhat paradaa paachhai jee kee maanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Deceived by doubt, you may hide your actions, but in the end, you shall have to confess the secrets of your mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit laae tit tit laage kiaa ko karai paraanee ||
lines.translation: Whatever they are attached to, they remain joined to that. What can any mere mortal do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: bakhas laihu paarabraham suaamee naanak sad kurabaanee ||2||6||128||
lines.translation: Please, forgive me, O Supreme Lord Master. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||6||128||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: apune sevak kee aape raakhai aape naam japaavai ||
lines.translation: He Himself preserves His servants; He causes them to chant His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਾਜ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah kaaj kirat sevak kee tahaa tahaa uth dhaavai ||1||
lines.translation: Wherever the business and affairs of His servants are, there the Lord hurries to be. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਿਕਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak kau nikatee hoi dikhaavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord appears near at hand to His servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo kahai thaakur pahi sevak tatakaal hoi aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever the servant asks of his Lord and Master, immediately comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis sevak kai hau balihaaree jo apane prabh bhaavai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to that servant, who is pleasing to his God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee soi sunee man hariaa tis naanak parasan aavai ||2||7||129||
lines.translation: Hearing of his glory, the mind is rejuvenated; Nanak comes to touch his feet. ||2||7||129||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ghar 11 mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Eleventh House, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟੂਆ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: natooaa bhekh dikhaavai bahu bidh jaisaa hai ohu taisaa re ||
lines.translation: The actor displays himself in many disguises, but he remains just as he is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik jon bhramio bhram bheetar sukhahi naahee paravesaa re ||1||
lines.translation: The soul wanders through countless incarnations in doubt, but it does not come to dwell in peace. ||1||
